projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop a 2D interactive map web application for the Faculty
of Science, King Mongkut’s University of Technology Thonburi. It facilitates students, staff,
and visitors in locating buildings and classrooms, resolving navigation difficulties caused by
the limitations of traditional maps.
 Accessible directly without a login, the system features Pixel Art graphics and virtual
Non-Player Character (NPCs) to present location information interactively. Users can easily
explore the area, search for buildings, view their current position, and generate walking paths
to their destinations. This project reduces navigation confusion, improves convenience, and
modernizes the presentation of faculty information through a highly accessible platform.

projects.title_en: Development of the Munae Web Application: A Personalized and Ingredient-Based Menu Recommendation System
projects.title_th: การพัฒนาเว็บแอปพลิเคชัน Munae: ระบบแนะนำเมนูอาหารเฉพาะบุคคลตามวัตถุดิบ
projects.keywords: AI Food Recommendation, Ingredient Matching, Smart Pantry, Recipe Suggestion,
projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop Munae, a personalized and ingredient-based meal
recommendation web application, designed to address household ingredient management and
reduce food waste. The system enables users to utilize available ingredients efficiently, create
menus tailored to their preferences, and experience a more convenient approach to cooking.
 The system was developed using Next.js and MongoDB, incorporating machine learning
and computer vision for ingredient recognition from images, alongside an ingredient-matching
algorithm and user behavior learning to enhance recommendation accuracy.
 The system supports both guest and authenticated users, with core functionalities
including ingredient-to-menu matching, image-bหased ingredient analysis, AI-generated recipe
creation, and an intelligent assistant. Testing confirmed that all Functional and Non-Functional
Requirements were fully satisfied. Usability evaluation using the System Usability Scale (SUS)
among 13 participants yielded a mean score of 72.31 out of 100, classified as Good, while the
objective-based evaluation returned to a mean score of 4.41 out of 5.00, classified as at a High
level, demonstrating that the system effectively addresses user needs, reduces food waste, and
fosters motivation toward home cooking.

projects.title_en: Development of a Thai Document Question-Answering System Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Case Study of KMUTT Registrar
projects.title_th: การพัฒนาระบบตอบคำถามจากเอกสารภาษาไทยด้วยเทคนิค Retrieval-Augmented Generation: กรณีศึกษาสำนักทะเบียน มจธ.
projects.keywords: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Large Language Model, Embedding Model,
projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to design and develop a prototype question-answering system
for Thai-language documents using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques
for the Office of the Registrar at King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi. The
system is intended to reduce inaccuracies in Large Language Models (LLMs) and improve
the efficiency of information access by utilizing text documents and PDF files from 2020–
2025 as the knowledge base. The study also explores and compares different chunking
strategies and Thai-language embedding models for transforming and storing data in a
vector database to support information retrieval and automatic answer generation based
on RAG and Router RAG architectures.

 The experimental results demonstrate that the system can effectively retrieve
information related to registrar services and university regulations, while generating
answers that are consistent with the source documents. System performance was
evaluated using five metrics: Context Relevance, Context Precision, Answer Relevance,
Answer Correctness, and Faithfulness. The overall average score achieved was 87%,
exceeding the predefined threshold of 70%. These results highlight the potential of
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques for effectively and reliably applying
Thai-language document question-answering systems to registrar services and
educational information support.

projects.title_en: Jobby: A Skill-Based Job Matching Platform Using User Skill Analysis
projects.title_th: Jobby: แพลตฟอร์มจับคู่งานด้วยการวิเคราะห์ทักษะของผู้ใช้
projects.keywords: Graph Database, Job Platform, Neo4j, Skill Gap, Skill Matching
projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop “Jobby: A Skill-Based Job Matching Platform using User
Skill Analysis,” a web application designed to support job searching and recruitment by using
user skills as the primary factor for matching job seekers with suitable job positions. The system
was developed to address the mismatch between applicants’ skills and labor market
requirements, which affects employment opportunities and recruitment efficiency.
 The platform supports two user roles: job seekers and employers. Job seekers can
manage personal profiles, upload resumes, search and apply for jobs, and track application
statuses. While employers can create job postings, review applicant information, and evaluate
candidates based on relevant skills and qualifications.
 For data management, PostgreSQL is used to store relational data such as user profiles,
job postings, and application records, while Neo4j is utilized to analyze relationships among
skills, users, and job positions. The graph-based structure supports skill relationship analysis
and Skill Gap Analysis.
 The results demonstrate that the prototype successfully supports the core
functionalities of a job platform, including user management, job applications, and graph-based
skill data storage. However, the system should be further improved in terms of matching
accuracy and evaluation with a larger group of real users.
projects.abstract_th:
โครงงานนี้มีวัตถุประสงค์เพื่อพัฒนาเว็บแอปพลิเคชัน Jobby: แพลตฟอร์มหางานด้วยการวิเคราะห์และ
จับคู่ทักษะของผู้ใช้ เพื่อสนับสนุนการหางานและการคัดเลือกผู้สมัครโดยใช้ทักษะเป็นปัจจัยหลักในการจับคู่
ระหว่างผู้หางานและต าแหน่งงาน แนวคิดของระบบเกิดจากปัญหาการได้งานไม่ตรงสายการศึกษาและความไม่
สอดคล้องระหว่างทักษะของผู้สมัครกับความต้องการของตลาดแรงงาน ซึ่งส่งผลต่อโอกาสในการท างานและ
ประสิทธิภาพในการสรรหาบุคลากร
 ระบบรองรับผู้ใช้งาน 2 บทบาท ได้แก่ ผู้หางานและนายจ้าง โดยผู้หางานสามารถจัดการข้อมูลส่วนตัว
อัปโหลดประวัติส่วนตัว (Resume) ค้นหาและสมัครงาน รวมถึงติดตามสถานะการสมัครงานได้ ขณะที่นายจ้าง
สามารถสร้างประกาศรับสมัครงาน ตรวจสอบข้อมูลผู้สมัคร และพิจารณาผู้สมัครตามทักษะที่เกี่ยวข้องกับ
ตาแหน่งงาน
 ระบบใช้ PostgreSQL ส าหรับจัดเก็บข้อมูลเชิงสัมพันธ์ และใช้ Neo4j ส าหรับจัดเก็บและวิเคราะห์
ความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างทักษะ ผู้ใช้งาน และตาแหน่งงาน เพื่อรองรับการวิเคราะห์ความเชื่อมโยงของทักษะและการ
วิเคราะห์ช่องว่างทักษะ (Skill Gap Analysis)
 ผลการด าเนินงานแสดงให้เห็นว่าระบบต้นแบบสามารถรองรับกระบวนการหลักของแพลตฟอร์มหางาน

projects.title_en: NeuroGami: A Battle Pet Training Game That Learns and Adapts Based on Experience
projects.title_th: NeuroGami: เกมฝึกสัตว์เลี้ยงต่อสู้ที่เรียนรู้และปรับตัวตามประสบการณ์
projects.keywords: Auto Battler/ Deep Reinforcement Learning/ Raising Simulation/ Unity/ Visual Pet
projects.abstract_en:
The objective of this thesis is to develop "NeuroGami", a Simulation Auto Battler game that applies
Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to generate unique combat behaviors for individual monsters. Furthermore,
the study examines the learning efficiency of AI agents across environments with varying complexities and aims
to cultivate an emotional bond between players and their raised monsters. Developed using the Unity Engine
and Unity ML-Agents Toolkit, the combat outcomes and behavioral patterns of the monsters in the arena
depend entirely on the training experiences and care provided by the players. Regarding the AI design, the
reward function was refined to be simple and balanced between rewards and penalties to mitigate reward
hacking issues caused by over-complex designs in previous iterations. Consequently, the monsters across all
three behavior profiles successfully developed combat strategies aligned with the intended design. Satisfaction
evaluations from a sample of 24 participants yielded an overall average score of 4.21 out of 5, reflecting the
game's success in effectively delivering a novel, challenging player experience that stimulates an emotional
connection with the characters.
projects.abstract_th:

projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop a web application to support and manage the Work
Integrated Learning process within the university. The system helps reduce paperwork and
improves coordination between students, advisors, staff, and workplace mentors.

 The system supports multiple user roles, including students, advisors, staff members,
and workplace mentors. Main features include student and company management, internship
applications, status tracking, document management, internship evaluation, and advisor visit
tracking. DevOps concepts were also applied to support system development and maintenance.

 The results show that the system helps reduce repetitive tasks, improves information
tracking, and supports better communication among people involved in the WIL program.

projects.keywords: Anomaly detection, Anomaly classification, Explainable AI (XAI), Large
projects.abstract_en:
This project develops a model for detecting and classifying network anomalies
with explainable decision-making to support threat analysis, using the CSE-CIC-IDS2018
dataset across four attack types: DDoS Attack-HOIC, DDoS Attack-LOIC HTTP, DoS Attack-
Hulk, and BOT. Experiments were conducted in three phases. The first phase evaluated
two model groups: 1. Random Forest with SHAP, and 2. CNN/LSTM/Transformers with
Integrated Gradients. After obtaining the models, they were applied in conjunction with
an LLM, specifically OpenAI's language model to explain the models' decision-making
reasoning in an easily understandable text format. The second phase extended the
models to detect Unknown Attacks, and the third phase tested generalizability on an
external dataset. Results show that Random Forest achieved high detection and
classification performance, and when combined with Isolation Forest effectively
handled Unknown Attacks, though limitations remained in detecting Infiltration attacks.
Performance declined on the external dataset due to data distribution differences.

projects.title_th: Moonbloom: เกมต่อสู้แบบผลัดกันเล่น 2.5 มิติที่มีกลไกปรับการจดจ่อเพื่อเพิ่มประสบการณ์ผู้เล่น
projects.keywords: Adaptive Focus Mechanism, K-means Clustering, Player Behavior,
projects.abstract_en:
Turn-based games maintain continuous popularity, but often feature rigid mechanics
that lead to player boredom and repetitiveness. To address this, this project proposes an
Adaptive Focus Mechanism designed to adjust character abilities to align with individual
playstyles. The system collects behavioral data such as skill utilization, resource management,
and decision making to classify players into three groups Risk Seeking Player (RS), Strategic
Player (SP), and Adaptive Player (AP). This classification uses K-means Clustering, the most
suitable model for the data (Silhouette Score: 0.4467, Davies-Bouldin Index: 1.0120). For
evaluation, player testing comparing standard and Adaptive Focus versions revealed an
improved balance between challenge and enjoyment. However, overall differences were
marginal due to the mechanism's partial implementation and limited gameplay impact.

projects.abstract_en:
This project presents the development of an AI Trading Assistant application
designed to analyze financial market trends, generate automated trading signals, and provide
investment guidance through an AI Chatbot. The system adopts a 3-Tier Architecture using
Flutter for the frontend, NestJS and PostgreSQL for backend processing and database
management, and Python with FastAPI for AI services. The AI framework operates in two
stages: Trend Detection using HMM, GMM, ADX, and Supertrend, and Signal Generation using
Machine Learning to produce BUY, SELL, and HOLD recommendations with automated Stop
Loss and Trailing Stop calculations.
 System performance was evaluated through a 2-year backtest across five financial
markets: S&P500, FTSE, SET, Gold, and Bitcoin. The results show that the proposed AI strategy
outperformed the traditional Buy & Hold strategy in all tested markets. Gold achieved the
highest excess return (Alpha) of +240.91%, while in the Bitcoin market the AI strategy
remained profitable despite losses in the benchmark strategy. Additionally, the integrated AI
Chatbot effectively provided analytical insights and investment recommendations through
natural language interaction. Overall, the developed system successfully achieved its
objective as a comprehensive and efficient investment decision-support tool.

projects.title_th: ระบบสร้างแผนที่อัตโนมัติสำหรับเกมไขปริศนามุมมองด้านข้างแบบไม่มีที่สิ้นสุด 2 มิติ
projects.keywords: 2D Puzzle Game, Procedural Content Generation, Dynamic Difficulty
projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop an automatic map generation system for a two-
dimensional side-scrolling puzzle game and to study the variables that affect game
difficulty. The system applies to Procedural Content Generation (PCG) together with
Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment (DDA) to generate diverse stages and automatically
adjust the difficulty level to suit each individual player.
 The developed system analyzes game difficulty based on player behavior data,
such as completion time, number of actions, and failure rate, using a Weighted Scoring
Model. The relationship between the difficulty values obtained from the model and
the perceived difficulty of players and experts was then analyzed using Spearman’s
Rank Correlation Coefficient. The experimental results showed that the model could
reflect the difficulty level of each stage in accordance with the perceptions of both
players and experts. In addition, the evaluation results from 15 participants indicated
that players had a positive gameplay experience, and the system was able to adjust
the difficulty at a moderately appropriate level.

projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop a management information system for an elderly
care center to resolve delays and errors from scattered data, reduce redundant tasks
for medical staff, and facilitate health communication between the center and families.
 Developed as a responsive web application, the front-end uses Next.js and
Tailwind CSS, while the back-end utilizes Go (Fiber) and PostgreSQL. It implements five
user roles to ensure Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) compliance. Core features
include resident profiles, electronic medical record (EMR) management, vital sign
recording, medication and meal planning, activities, basic inventory, and a portal for
relatives.
 Evaluation results show the system fully meets requirements, passing all user
acceptance testing (UAT) cases. It also achieved an "Excellent" system usability scale
(SUS) score of 85. In conclusion, the system is highly practical, effectively enhancing
operational speed, minimizing medical errors, and promoting transparency in elderly
care.

ส่วนติดต่อผู้ใช้งานพัฒนาด้วย Next.js และ Tailwind CSS ส่วนระบบหลังบ้านใช้ภาษา Go (Fiber)

projects.title_th: Wealth & Vault: แอปพลิเคชันสำหรับรวบรวมและจัดการทรัพย์สินของครอบครัว
projects.keywords: Asset Management, Mobile Application, Clean Architecture, Microservices
projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop the Wealth & Vault application for collecting and
managing family assets in a digital format (Digital Asset Management) to address the problem
of financial data and important documents being scattered and disorganized. The system
was developed using Clean Architecture combined with Microservices Architecture to support
secure shared access within the family. Key features include asset value overview, data
addition and editing, access permission management, and important schedule notifications.
Evaluation results from a sample group of 11 participants found that the system provides
families with a secure centralized platform for storing asset information, reduces the risk of
document loss, and concretely improves the efficiency of collaborative financial planning.

projects.keywords: Flood Risk mapping, Machine learning, Geographic Information Systems
projects.abstract_en:
This research analyzes flood-prone areas in Nakhon Pathom Province by integrating
Geographic Information Systems (GIS), remote sensing, and machine learning techniques with
spatiotemporal data spanning 2011–2025, a total of 10,000 survey points were collected over
15 years. Eight models were developed and compared, including Random Forest, XGBoost,
LightGBM, CatBoost, ANN, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and SVM, along with a Voting
Ensemble model. Spatial Block Split was applied to prevent spatial data leakage, while
SMOTE-Tomek was used to address class imbalance.
 The Voting Ensemble achieved the highest performance with an AUC-ROC of 0.9245
and a Kappa of 0.4454. SHAP analysis revealed that the most influential factors were the Low
Elevation Near River Index, Drainage Risk Index, elevation, and annual rainfall. The resulting
risk map identified high and very high-risk areas covering 41.1% of the province, concentrated
along the Tha Chin River corridor across Nakhon Chai Si, Sam Phran, and Bang Len districts.
The findings inform a three-phase policy framework for sustainable flood prevention and
mitigation planning.

projects.title_en: Sword & Spoon : A Learning Game on Basic Accounting for Students Using Simulated Scenarios
projects.title_th: Sword & Spoon: เกมเรียนรู้บัญชีพื้นฐานสำหรับนักศึกษาผ่านสถานการณ์จำลอง

projects.abstract_en:
The Sword & Spoon project is a 2D top-down game developed using Unity
and C#. It aims to integrate fundamental accounting concepts—such as double-entry
bookkeeping, accounts payable, and accounts receivable—into gameplay mechanics
to create an interactive learning experience for a target audience aged 14–24. The
game features restaurant management and cooking via Quick Time Event mechanics,
dungeon exploration for ingredient gathering, and complex business simulation
systems. These include purchasing ingredients on credit with accrued interest,
managing debtors through a mailbox system, and bookkeeping via a Journal Manager
that provides immediate feedback to players.
 Regarding performance results, system testing across 10 test cases was
successful, and the project received an average satisfaction score of 81.33 out of 100
from the target group. It performed exceptionally well in usability, scoring 4.41 out of
5. Although the game is currently limited to Windows and macOS platforms, covers
only basic content, and lacks a save/load system, future plans include expanding the
scope to cover financial statement preparation, extending support to mobile platforms,
and developing a teacher dashboard to systematically track student progress.

projects.abstract_en:
The PhoSS-Care project aims to develop a mobile application designed to streamline
patient data management and appointment scheduling for Phosisuwan Hospital in Sisaket Province. As a
community hospital, the facility provides essential healthcare services, including general medicine, chronic
non-communicable disease (NCD) management—such as diabetes and hypertension—as well as
tuberculosiscare and pediatric immunization services.
 Currently, the hospital faces challenges due to a growing patient population and a reliance on paper-
based documentation. The use of physical records for appointment slips, medical histories, and clinical
documents frequently leads to document loss, missed appointments, and significant delays in data
administration. These inefficiencies hinder the continuity of care and overall operational fluidity. The expected
outcomes of the PhoSS-Care system development are demonstrated by the positive user satisfaction ratings.
These results serve as a key indicator that the system effectively minimizes appointment no-shows and
streamlines access to medical information, ultimately enhancing the hospital’s service quality and operational
efficiency.

projects.title_th: LearnVelUp: แอปพลิเคชันการเรียนรู้แบบไมโครเลิร์นนิงผ่านวิดีโอสั้นแนวตั้งร่วมกับเกมิฟิเคชัน
projects.keywords: Microlearning, Gamification, Vertical Short-form Videos, Course Recommendation
projects.abstract_en:
The LearnVelUp project is an online microlearning application utilizing vertical short-form
videos, developed to support digital-age learners who require concise, accessible, and flexible
learning content that can be accessed anytime and anywhere. The system integrates gamification
concepts to enhance learner motivation and engagement through various features, including point
collection, achievement badges, daily missions, an energy system, progress tracking, and game-
based quizzes at the end of lessons. In addition, the application provides a course
recommendation system based on the Content-Based Filtering technique to suggest learning
content that matches users’ interests. A back-office management system is also implemented to
allow instructors and administrators to manage courses, lessons, and quizzes efficiently. The
system was developed using technologies such as Expo React Native, Next.js, FastAPI, and
Supabase to support both mobile and web-based platforms.

projects.title_th: ระบบแปลภาษาแบบเรียลไทม์ที่คำนึงถึงอารมณ์และบริบท
projects.keywords: English-to-Thai Translation, Large Language Model, SFT, DPO, Human
projects.abstract_en:
This research aims to develop and evaluate English-to-Thai translation models
focusing on naturalness, contextual understanding, and emotional accuracy. The training
data were collected from web scraping and data synthetic English-to-Thai The models
were fine-tuned using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization
(DPO).
 The experiments compared HY-MT1.5-1.8B and typhoon-translate1.5-4b using
LLM-as-a-Judge, Human Preference evaluation, inference speed, and resource usage. The
results show that HY-MT1.5-1.8B provides advantages in speed and resource efficiency
but still has limitations in contextual accuracy and naturalness. In contrast, typhoon-
translate1.5-4b was preferred by users for more natural and context-aware translation.
However, SFT+DPO did not always improve performance and could reduce quality in
some cases.
 In conclusion, data quality, model selection, and multi-dimensional evaluation
are important factors in developing effective English-to-Thai translation models.

projects.keywords: Lie Detection / Body Pose Analysis / OpenPose
projects.abstract_en:
Lie detection through body behavior analysis has gained significant attention in
psychology and digital forensics research, as body gestures and posture serve as
involuntary signals that are difficult to consciously suppress during deception. However,
most existing research has primarily focused on facial expressions and vocal cues,
leaving body pose analysis relatively underexplored. This project aims to develop a lie
detection system based on body pose analysis using deception detection accuracy. The
evaluation uses a self-collected video dataset recorded from volunteers under
controlled conditions. The developed system consists of a frontend built with Next.js
14 and TypeScript, and a backend powered by FastAPI (Python), with data stored in
MongoDB and authentication handled via JWT and Google OAuth. Experimental results
indicate that the developed model achieves high deception detection accuracy within
the same dataset. However, its performance degrades during cross-dataset validation
due to variations in environmental conditions, providing guidance for researchers and
developers selecting body pose estimation tools for deception detection tasks in
psychological and digital forensics research, as body gestures are signal that are difficult
to control during deception. However, most existing research has primarily focused on
facial expressions and vocal cues, leaving body pose analysis relatively underexplored.

projects.title_en: Machine Learning Approaches for Identifying Candidate Beneficial Microbes Associated with Feed Conversion Ratio in the Thai Broiler Industry
projects.title_th: การประยุกต์การเรียนรู้ของเครื่องเพื่อค้นหาจุลินทรีย์ที่อาจมีประโยชน์ต่ออัตราการเปลี่ยนอาหารเป็นเนื้อในอุตสาหกรรมไก่เนื้อไทย
projects.keywords: Broiler, Candidate Beneficial Microbes, Feed Conversion Ratio, Machine
projects.abstract_en:
The broiler chicken industry is one of Thailand's major revenue-generating
industries. A key factor affecting production costs is the Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR).
Over the years, various approaches have been used to reduce FCR in order to cut feed
costs, pushing it close to its biological limit. This study therefore focuses on applying
Machine Learning combined with Feature Selection methods to identify gut microbial
groups that may play a role in FCR in broiler chickens.
 The analysis used microbiome data at the Genus level and Amplicon Sequence
Variant (ASV) level from cecal samples of chickens at 17, 28, and 39 days of age, totaling
395 samples. Data was normalized using Centered Log-Ratio (CLR) transformation and
rarefaction. Three feature selection methods were used, including Minimum
Redundancy Maximum Relevance (mRMR), Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE), and
Elastic Net, combined with Support Vector Machine (SVM), XGBoost, and Random
Forest algorithms, in both classification and regression tasks.

projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to design and develop a web-based inventory management system for

IT equipment at the Department of Mathematics, King Mongkut’s University of Technology

Thonburi. The system enhances the efficiency of borrowing and returning processes, supports

real-time status tracking, and reduces administrative workload. It is built with Next.js, Node.js and

PostgreSQL, using Figma for UI design and Git for version control. ABC analysis is integrated to

prioritize equipment based on usage and value. User testing indicates improved convenience,

accuracy, and clearer inventory visibility, contributing to more effective planning and resource

utilization.

projects.title_th: สนามเรียนรู้ปัญญาประดิษฐ์เชิงโต้ตอบ
projects.keywords: Interactive Learning, Visualization, Simulation, Artificial Intelligence, Data Structure,
projects.abstract_en:
This project, Artificial Intelligence Interactive Playground, aims to develop an interactive
web-based learning platform that facilitates the understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI), data
structures, and algorithms through visual simulation and user interaction. The system will allow
users, especially students, to explore computer science concepts hands-on by engaging with
simulations that visually demonstrate how concepts such as image processing and sorting
algorithms operate. By providing real-time feedback and step-by-step visualizations, the platform
enhances conceptual understanding and encourages experiential learning. Built with modern web
technologies including Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and deployed via Vercel using a
serverless architecture, the project ensures responsiveness and scalability across devices. The
interactive learning environment not only simplifies complex computer science topics but also
fosters deeper engagement and retention through intuitive and user-friendly design. This platform
is envisioned as a valuable educational tool for both self-learners and classroom use, contributing
to a more engaging and effective computer science education.

projects.title_en: “Pet Village” Platform for Buying, Selling and Adopting Pets
projects.title_th: Pet Village: แพลตฟอร์มซื้อ ขาย และรับเลี้ยงสัตว์เลี้ยง
projects.keywords: สัตว์จรจัด, แอปพลิเคชันมือถือ, การรับเลี้ยงสัตว์, ความรับผิดชอบในการเลี้ยงสัตว์
projects.abstract_en:
At present, the issue of stray animals in Thailand remains a major concern that affects
multiple dimensions, particularly public health and the environment. The root causes are
largely due to pet owners’ lack of responsibility and inadequate knowledge about proper
animal care, which often leads to pet abandonment. Although there are organizations and
volunteer groups working to help stray animals, there is still a lack of an efficient central
platform to connect those who want to help or adopt animals.

 This project aims to develop a mobile application called "Pet Village", which serves as a
medium for pet trading and a channel to find new homes for stray animals. The app focuses on
promoting responsible pet ownership and reducing the number of stray animals in the long
term. The main features of Pet Village include a posting system for selling or rehoming pets, a
filtering system for more convenient searching, a chat system for user communication, a favorite
system for liking pets, and a blog area for sharing knowledge about pet care.
projects.abstract_th:

ทั้งด้านสาธารณสุขและสิ่งแวดล้อม โดยมีสาเหตุหลักจากการขาดความรับผิดชอบของผู้เลี้ยงสัตว์ รวมถึงการขาด
ความรู้ความเข้าใจที่ถูกต้องในการดูแลสัตว์เลี้ยง ส่งผลให้มีการทอดทิ้งสัตว์อย่างต่อเนื่อง แม้จะมีองค์กรและกลุ่ม
อาสาสมัครที่ช่วยเหลือสัตว์จรจัด แต่ยังขาดแพลตฟอร์มกลางที่มีประสิทธิภาพในการเชื่อมโยงผู้ที่ต้องการช่วยเหลือ
หรือรับเลี้ยงสัตว์จรจัดเข้าด้วยกัน

 โครงงานนี้จึงมีวัตถุประสงค์เพื่อพัฒนาแอปพลิเคชันสําหรับโทรศัพท์มือถือภายใต้ชื่อ "Pet Village"
ซึ่งทําหน้าที่เป็นตัวกลางในการซื้อขายสัตว์เลี้ยง รวมถึงเป็นช่องทางสําหรับการหาบ้านใหม่ให้กับสัตว์จรจัด
โดยมุ่งเน้นการส่งเสริมจิตสํานึกในการเลี้ยงสัตว์อย่างมีความรับผิดชอบ และลดจํานวนสัตว์จรจัดในระยะยาว
โดยแอปพลิเคชัน Pet Village จะประกอบด้วย ระบบโพสต์ขายหรือหาบ้านให้สัตว์เลี้ยง ระบบการกรองเพื่อการ
ค้นหาที่สะดวกยิ่งขึ้น ระบบแชตระหว่างผู้ใช้งาน ระบบกดชื่นชอบสัตว์เลี้ยง และพื้นที่แลกเปลี่ยนความรู้ด้านการ

projects.title_en: Telemedicine Platform for Help Patient in Remote Village
projects.title_th: แพลตฟอร์มการแพทย์ทางไกลเพื่อช่วยผู้ป่วยในพื้นที่ห่างไกล
projects.keywords: Accuracy, Finetune, Internet of things (IoT), Large Language Model
projects.abstract_en:
A Telemedicine platform for help patients in remote village was developed with
the goal to solved basic medical concerns and improving healthcare accessibility for
patients in remote areas. It also aims to reduce the ongoing shortage of medical
personnels in Thailand. The system integrates Internet of Things (IoT) technology with a
Large Language Model (LLM) to create a medical question-answering device. Users can
interact with the device to ask medical questions without requiring an internet
connection.

 The performance of the LLM has been enhanced using techniques such as fine-
tuning with Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) and model size reduction through
4-bit quantization. These optimizations result in improved speed, accuracy, and a smaller
model size, achieving an accuracy of 81.67%. With these advancements, the platform
has potential for further development to increase its effectiveness in the future.
projects.abstract_th:
แพลตฟอร์มแพทย์ทางไกลเพื่อช่วยเหลือผู้ป่วยในที่ห่างไกลถูกพัฒนาขึ้นโดยมีจุดประสงค์เพื่อต
อบปัญหาทางการแพทย์ในเบื้องต้นและเพิ่มโอกาสการเข้าถึงผู้ป่วยในพื้นที่ห่างไกล รวมไปถึง
การแก้ปัญหาบุคลากรทางการแพทย์ที่ขาดแคลนที่กําลังเกิดขึ้นในประเทศไทย โดยเป็นการพัฒนา
อุปกรณ์เทคโนโลยีที่เป็น Internet of things(IoT) ประยุกต์เข้ากับ Large Language Model (LLM)
ก่อให้เกิดเป็นอุปกรณ์ตอบคําถามทางการแพทย์ผู้ใช้งานจะสามารถามคําถามทางการแพทย์กับอุปกร
ณ์ได้โดยไม่จําเป็นต้องใช้สัญญาณอินเทอร์เน็ต

 อีกทั้งยังมีการเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพของ LLM ขึ้น ด้วยเทคนิคต่างๆ เช่น การ Finetune ด้วย
Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) หรือ การลดขนาดโมเดลด้วย 4-Bit Quatization
ส่งผลให้ประสิทธิภาพในด้าน ความเร็ว ความถูกต้อง ดีขึ้น และมีขนาดของ Model ที่เล็กลง โดยมี
Accuracy อยู่ที่ 81.67% ด้วยเทคนิคต่างๆที่นําเสนอยังสามารถพัฒนาต่อไปได้เพื่อให้มีประสิทธิภาพ
ที่ดีขึ้นต่อไปในอนาคต

projects.title_th: เว็บไซต์ซื้อขายชิ้นส่วนและอะไหล่ยานยนต์
projects.keywords: Website, Automotive Parts, Odoo, ERP, E-commerce
projects.abstract_en:
In the digital era where online commerce is rapidly growing, developing platforms for niche
products such as automotive parts and components has become increasingly important. This project
focuses on the development of a website for selling automotive parts using Odoo, an open-source
ERP system that offers a wide range of features and can be customized to meet specific business
needs. The developed website includes key functionalities such as product listings, online ordering,
order status tracking and a customer issue reporting system. It also provides an order management
system for administrators or sellers, which helps reduce redundant processes, enhances service
efficiency, and improves data management. By implementing Odoo, the platform can seamlessly
integrate systems within the organization, supporting business expansion in the future and effectively
meeting the needs of both customers and suppliers.

มุ่งเน้นการพัฒนาเว็บไซต์ขายชิ้นส่วนและอะไหล่ยานยนต์โดยใช้ระบบ Odoo ซึ่งเป็นระบบ ERP
แบบโอเพนซอร์สที่มีความสามารถหลากหลายและสามารถปรับแต่งได้ตามความต้องการของธุรกิจ

หรือผู้ขาย ช่วยลดขั้นตอนการท างานที่ซ้าซ้อน เพิ่มความรวดเร็วในการให้บริการ และเพิ่ม

This research project focuses on the development of an artificial intelligence model for
detecting abnormalities in cervical cells using Pap smear slide images. Pap smear screening is
one of the most widely adopted methods for early detection of cervical cancer in Thailand,
involving the microscopic examination of cervical cell morphology to identify potential pre-
cancerous or cancerous changes. However, the interpretation of Pap smear results requires the
expertise of trained cytotechnologists and pathologists, whose availability is limited.
Furthermore, although there exists a large repository of Pap smear images, the majority lack
proper annotation, which significantly limits their usability for training automated diagnostic
systems.
In this project, a curated dataset of Pap smear images with appropriate labeling has been
compiled and utilized to train machine learning and deep learning models. These models are
designed to classify cells into normal and abnormal categories with high accuracy. The proposed
system aims to enhance the effectiveness of cervical cancer screening, alleviate the workload of
healthcare professionals, and improve access to screening services, particularly in underserved or
remote areas.

projects.keywords: Online Platform, Swimming Lessons, Web Application, Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Stripe
projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop an online web platform for connecting swimming learners with
swimming coaches, addressing issues of difficult searching, lack of reliability in existing online
channels, and enhancing convenience for both parties. The platform was developed following a standard
system development process, utilizing key technologies including Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Firebase
Authentication, and Stripe. The developed platform includes core functionalities covering user and
profile management, searching for instructors and courses, the course application and booking process,
in-system payment for courses, progress tracking within the 'My Course' system, course and student
management for instructors, and user and instructor request management for administrators. Based on
internal testing and initial user acceptance testing, the system was found to function correctly for the
developed core features, and target users perceived the system as having the potential to facilitate and
increase reliability in finding swimming instructors. This platform serves as a vital foundation for
improving the experience of searching for and managing swimming lessons online.

projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop an Artificial Intelligence (AI) model to classify the
severity levels of urinary tract diseases in animals, such as Urinary Tract Infections (UTIs),
urinary tract stones, and kidney damage. The model utilizes data from patient medical
histories and laboratory test results to assess disease severity. The project employs machine
learning techniques to analyze and classify the severity of various urinary tract diseases. After
evaluating multiple models using AutoML, the top three performers identified were: CatBoost
XGBoost and LightGBM Upon testing, the selected models achieved an accuracy of
approximately 83% and an F1-score of around 82%. These results indicate that the AI
models can effectively classify the severity of urinary tract diseases in animals to a certain
extent. In addition, this project has developed a system for diagnosing the severity of urinary
tract infections in animals and has been used by stakeholders in trials. According to the
survey, the results are at a good level. However, to increase the reliability and performance
of future models. Further studies should be conducted using large and diverse datasets,
including testing models in real-world environments, to assess the practicality of this
diagnostic system.

projects.title_en: Thai Bus Number Detection System for the Visually Impaired
projects.title_th: ระบบตรวจจับหมายเลขรถโดยสารประจำทางไทยเพื่อผู้พิการทางสายตา
projects.abstract_en:
An automatic bus stop sign detection system for visually impaired individuals has been
developed to enable them to access public transportation conveniently and independently. The system
focuses on helping visually impaired users recognize the bus number when it arrives at the stop,
addressing the issue of their inability to see the bus stop sign. Additionally, the project aims to serve as
a foundation for real-time bus detection, enhancing the convenience for both the general public and
visually impaired individuals.
In the development process of this project, several technologies and tools have been utilized, including
Roboflow, YOLO, and CNN, to manage data and train various models. The process starts with
managing bus stop sign images in Roboflow, followed by training the YOLO and CNN models to
improve detection accuracy. Once the models are trained, they will be used to detect bus stop signs to
assist visually impaired individuals in the next steps. Furthermore, the performance of various models is
compared to enhance and improve the quality of detection and the effectiveness of assisting visually
impaired individuals.
projects.abstract_th:
ระบบตรวจจับป้ายรถเมล์อัตโนมัติเพื่อผู้พิการทางสายตาถูกพัฒนาขึ้นเพื่อให้ผู้พิการทางสายตาสามารถ
เข้าถึงระบบขนส่งสาธารณะได้อย่างสะดวกและเป็นอิสระ โดยมุ่งเน้นที่การช่วยให้ผู้พิการสามารถรับรู้
หมายเลขของรถเมล์ที่ต้องการได้เมื่อรถเมล์มาถึงป้าย จึงแก้ปัญหาของผู้พิการทางสายตาที่ไม่สามารถ
มองเห็นป้ายรถเมล์ได้ นอกจากนี้ โครงงานยังมุ่งเน้นพัฒนาเป็นรากฐานส าหรับการตรวจจับรถเมล์ใน
ลักษณะเรียลไทม์เพื่อเพิ่มความสะดวกสบายให้กับบุคคลทั่วไปและผู้พิการทางสายตา
ในกระบวนการพัฒนาโครงงานนี้ ได้ใช้เทคโนโลยีและเครื่องมือหลายประเภท ได้แก่ Roboflow, YOLO,
และ CNN เพื่อใช้ในการจัดการข้อมูลและการฝึกฝนโมเดลต่างๆ โดยเริ่มจากการจัดการข้อมูลภาพป้าย
รถเมล์ใน Roboflow ก่อนที่จะนาไปฝึกฝนโมเดล YOLO และ CNN เพื่อเพิ่มความแม่นย าในการตรวจจับ
ป้ายรถเมล์ เมื่อโมเดลได้รับการฝึกฝนแล้วจะถูกนาไปใช้ในการตรวจจับป้ายรถเมล์เพื่อช่วยเหลือผู้พิการ

projects.keywords: Procedural Content Generation, Graph Rewrite, Dungeon Map, Game Design, 2D Games
projects.abstract_en:
This research aimed to design and developed a 2D dungeon map generation process for games
using Procedural Content Generation (PCG) techniques based on the principles of Graph
Rewrite. The goal was to create complex and diverse dungeon maps. The process began with
the construction of a basic graph consisting of nodes, which represent rooms in the map, and
edges, which represent pathways between the rooms. Rewrite Rules were then applied to
restructure the graph to align with the desired design objectives.

The project also involved the development of algorithms to manage the complexity of
dungeon structures, optimize resource allocation within the game, and refine various elements
to enhance the completeness and appeal of the dungeon map. The resulting maps
demonstrate structural diversity, adaptability to developers' requirements, and the potential
to deliver unique gameplay experiences, particularly for 2D games with intricate designs.

projects.keywords: ระบบจดจําใบหน0า, YOLO, FaceNet, Flask, React
projects.abstract_en:
The development of a web-based application for real-time facial recognition aims to
enhance security and convenience in identifying individuals. The system was developed
using Python with the Flask framework for the backend and Next.js for the frontend,
connected to an SQLite database, which is suitable for small to medium-scale systems and
supports efficient storage of user information and facial vector data. The system integrates
artificial intelligence models, including YOLO for real-time face detection and FaceNet for
converting facial images into feature vectors (face embeddings) for identity comparison.
 The application’s core functionalities include capturing facial images via webcam,
analyzing and isolating faces, comparing facial vectors, notifying administrators when new
faces are detected, and allowing approval of new facial data into the database. After
development, the system was tested with a sample group of six participants. The results
showed that the system could recognize previously registered individuals at a satisfactory
level, despite some limitations in accuracy under certain conditions such as different face
angles or changes in appearance. Nevertheless, the system demonstrated real-time
processing capabilities, responsive web display, and ease of use for administrators. Therefore,
it has potential for real-world applications in various security systems in the future.

projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop a website for security testing of mobile applications—
specifically Android Package Kit (APK) and iOS App Store Package (IPA) files created with Flutter. In
an age where smart phones and apps play a central role in business, communication, and
entertainment, safeguarding application security has become imperative. Rigorous security testing
helps mitigate the risks of attacks and vulnerabilities that could compromise mobile apps.
 The platform enables users to upload APK or IPA files for automated security assessment.
They can select analysis modules—such as checks for tamper detection capabilities—and the
system will examine the application using relevant techniques and standards to pinpoint weaknesses
that attackers might exploit. This solution not only streamlines the security-assessment process but
also bolsters confidence among developers and end-users that their data and applications remain
protected.

projects.abstract_en:
This project aims to develop a website management system for a mathematics tutoring
institute at the secondary education level, focusing on enhancing the efficiency of managing
the institute’s online teaching and learning system. Previously, services were provided through
social media platforms such as TikTok and Line, which lacked the capability to systematically
store data or control the structure of the learning system. The technologies used in developing
the website include Next.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. The website is designed to operate in
two main sections: the user section and the admin section. In the admin section,
administrators can view, add, edit, and delete information related to courses, online live
course calendars, articles, student success stories, and manage user accounts. The user section
includes functions for user registration, login, course purchasing, video-based learning,
downloading learning materials, and viewing the live class schedule through an online
calendar.
 The system also includes access restrictions for courses, such as limiting access
duration based on the course validity period. After the development phase, the website was
tested with a sample group consisting of 10 general users and 2 administrators. The results
showed that the developed website effectively met the needs of both learners and
administrators. It also demonstrated the potential for further development to support future
expansion of the institute.

projects.title_en: Development of a Model for Detecting and Classifying Violence Between Children and Adults
projects.title_th: การพัฒนาแบบจำลองตรวจจับและจำแนกความรุนแรงระหว่างเด็กกับผู้ใหญ่

projects.abstract_en:
Currently, violence in educational institutions, childcare centers, and public areas remains a
problem that lacks real-time surveillance systems. This project aims to develop an AI model to detect
and classify violence between children and adults, using the NTU CCTV-Fights and RWF-2000
datasets, together with the Two-Stream and Temporal Robust Feature (TRoF) techniques for
extracting spatial and temporal features. The model using Optical Flow with Sigmoid function gave
an F1-score of 0.78 and a Recall of 0.87 on the RWF-2000 dataset and a Recall of 0.98 on the newly
labeled NTU dataset. For child and adult classification, YOLOv5 and YOLOv8 were used, with a
combined accuracy of 58.6%, and an accuracy of 71.8% for adult classification. The system was
developed as a real-time web application with video recording and accompanying data functions to
be used as evidence in retrospective investigations. Despite the limitations in data quality and
computer resources, the model shows its potential for practical application in violent surveillance
systems.

projects.title_en: Brain2Face: Face Image Generation from EEG
projects.title_th: Brain2Face: การสร้างภาพใบหน้าจากสัญญาณคลื่นไฟฟ้าสมอง
projects.keywords: สัญญาณคลื่นไฟฟ้าสมอง, การเรียนรู้ของเครื่อง, Ultracortex Mark IV
projects.abstract_en:
Electroencephalography (EEG) signals are currently used in many different sectors,
including controlling drones and improving gaming experiences. Using EEG data to create
graphics based on human thinking is an interesting application. The goal of this study is to use
EEG signals to describe the face features that people envision and to improve communication.
To create facial images that correspond with users' thoughts, machine learning technology is
used in conjunction with the 16-sensor Ultracortex Mark IV. This method offers improvements
in machine learning and neuroscience while demonstrating the potential of EEG to connect
ideas and visual representations.
projects.abstract_th:
ในปัจจุบัน สัญญาณคลื่นไฟฟ้าสมอง (Electroencephalography: EEG) ได้รับการนํามาประยุกต์ใช้
ในหลากหลายด้าน เช่น การควบคุมโดรนหรือการเพิ่มประสบการณ์การเล่นเกม อีกหนึ่งการประยุกต์ใช้ที่
น่าสนใจคือการใช้ข้อมูล EEG เพื่อสร้างภาพตามความคิดของมนุษย์ โครงงานนี้มุ่งเน้นการเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพใน
การสื่อสารและอธิบายใบหน้าของบุคคลที่นึกคิดผ่านการใช้สัญญาณคลื่นไฟฟ้าสมองโดยใช้อุปกรณ์
Ultracortex Mark IV ที่ติดตั้งเซนเซอร์ 16 จุดร่วมกับเทคโนโลยีการเรียนรู้ของเครื่อง (Machine Learning)
เพื่อสร้างภาพใบหน้าที่ตรงกับความคิดของผู้ใช้งาน วิธีการนี้แสดงให้เห็นถึงศักยภาพของ EEG ในการเชื่อมโยง
ระหว่างความคิดและการสร้างภาพ เสนอความก้าวหน้าใหม่ในด้านประสาทวิทยาศาสตร์และเทคโนโลยี

projects.title_en: E-Commerce Website with Donating Options for Second-Hand Products and Carbon Credit System
projects.title_th: เว็บไซต์พาณิชย์อิเล็กทรอนิกส์สำหรับซื้อขายและบริจาคสินค้ามือสองพร้อมระบบคาร์บอนเครดิต
projects.keywords: Carbon Credit, MERN Stack, MongoDB, Express, React, NodeJS, Web Application
projects.abstract_en:
The development of a web application for buying and selling second-hand goods and a carbon
credit system aims to enable trading of second-hand goods and earning carbon credit points. It also
helps support the reduction of global warming which is constantly increasing through the production
of new products. The technology used to develop the web application is MERN Stack, consisting of
MongoDB, Express, React, and NodeJS. within the web application There is a function to announce
4 types of products, including selling, buyer, donating, and requesting donations. Where users can
purchase products, offer to sell products, ask for donations, and offer donations. And there is also a
system for accumulating and exchanging carbon credit points. Which will be obtained from buying
products and donating products. Users can use the accumulated points for various uses, such as
exchanging money coupons or exchanging special privileges for those who want carbon credits, such
as Lotus’s, Starbucks, etc. After developing the web application, the system was tested with a sample
of 9 people and the results were collected to evaluate the use of the web application. The results of
the research found that web applications Can answer the needs of users who want to sell second-hand
items and it can also be something that can be developed in the future to reduce global warming.
projects.abstract_th:
กํารพัฒนําโปรแกรมประยุกต์บนเว็บส ําหรับซื้อขํายและบริจําคของมือสองและระบบ
คําร์บอนเครดิต มีจุดประสงค์เพื่อให้สํามํารถซื้อขํายสินค้ํามือสองพร้อมได้รับคําร์บอนเครดิต อีกทั้ง

เสนอขํายสินค้ํา ขอรับบริจําค และเสนอบริจําคได้ และยังมีระบบกํารสะสมและแลกคําร์บอนเครดิต
ซึ่งจะได้จํากกํารซื้อสินค้ําและบริจําคสินค้ํา ผู้ใช้สํามํารถน ําเครดิตที่สะสมไปใช้ประโยชน์ต่ําง ๆ ได้
เช่น น ําไปแลกคูปองเงินหรือไปแลกสิทธิพิเศษต่ําง ๆ ของผู้ที่ต้องกํารคําร์บอนเครดิต เช่น โลตัส

projects.title_th: การพัฒนาระบบบริหารจัดการบริษัทขนส่งสินค้าผ่านเว็บไซต์
projects.keywords: Efficiency Improvement, Trucking Company, Management System, Web-based
projects.abstract_en:
This project focused on the designing and the developing a management system for a
transportation company through a website. The objectives are to facilitate small-scale
trucking operations efficiently and easily. The website features include employee
management, vehicle management, job management, invoice management, receipt
management, and voucher management. After the development, the system was tested and
user satisfaction was evaluated from 10 users. The test results indicated that the developed
website has high user satisfaction, with an average score of 3.56 with a standard deviation of
0.88. The feedback received will be used to further enhance the system's efficiency.

โครงงานนี้มุ่งเน้นการออกแบบและพัฒนาระบบจัดการในบริษัทขนส่งผ่านเว็บไซต์ โดยมีวัตถุประสงค์

จัดการรถ การจัดการใบงาน การจัดการใบแจ้งหนี้ การจัดการใบเสร็จ และการจัดการใบส าคัญรับ/จ่าย

projects.title_en: Website for Managing Small Retail Spaces
projects.title_th: เว็บไซต์บริหารจัดการพื้นที่เช่าขนาดเล็กสำหรับธุรกิจจัดสรรพื้นที่จำหน่ายสินค้า
projects.keywords: การจัดการพื้นที่ขนาดเล็ก , ผู้ให้เช่าพื้นที่ , ผู้เช่า , CRM , Salesforce
projects.abstract_en:
This project is the designing of a website for event management using Customer Relationship Management
(CRM) system. The objective is to assist in managing rental spaces, where the space is divided into sections for
individuals interested in renting. The website perform as a space manager, verifying the status and advertising
the space for the renters, thus enhancing management efficiency. The design considers the principles of
Customer Relationship Management (CRM) to enable renters to manage their clients more effectively and create
satisfaction for them. This project utilized www.Salesforce.com, a cloud-based CRM program and thus divided
into two main sections: a section for displaying the space to interested individuals for rental and a section for
the space owner's management system. Staffs will be available to assist in using the website and monitoring
various statuses within the space. After developing the website, it was tested with a sample group of 10 people.
The evaluation results showed that overall satisfaction for space renters was high (mean = 3.81) and for space
tenants was also high (mean = 3.82).
projects.abstract_th:
โครงงานนี้เป็นการออกแบบเว็บไซต์บริหารจัดการอีเว้นท์ด้วยระบบการบริหารความสัมพันธ์กับลูกค้ามี

ผู้ให้เช่าพื้นที่ เพิ่มประสิทธิภาพในการจัดการ โดยคํานึงถึงหลักระบบการจัดการลูกค้าสัมพันธ์ หรือ CRM
(Customer Relationship Management) ที่เข้ามาช่วยให้ผู้ให้เช่าพื้นที่สามารถจัดการกับผู้เช่าพื้นที่ได้อย่างมี
ประสิทธิภาพมากขึ้น สร้างความพึงพอให้กับผู้เช่า โดยผู้วิจัยได้นําเว็บไซต์ www.Salesforce.com เป็นโปรแกรม
CRM ที่ทํางานบนระบบคลาวด์ มาใช้เป็นส่วนหนึ่งในเว็บไซต์ โดยภายในเว็บไซต์ถูกแบ่งเป็น 2 ส่วนหลักคือ
ส่วนที่ไว้จัดแสดงพื้นที่ให้บุคคลที่สนใจ เข้ามาติดต่อเช่าพื้นที่ และ ส่วนของระบบจัดการพื้นที่ของผู้ให้เช่าพื้นที่
โดยที่จะมีเจ้าหน้าที่คอยให้ความช่วยเหลือ ในการใช้งานเว็บไซต์ และดูสถานะต่างๆภายในพื้นที่ หลังจากพัฒนา

projects.title_th: การวิเคราะห์ความรู้สึกของนักลงทุนจากกิจกรรมบนเครือข่ายบล็อกเชน: กรณีศึกษา Ethereum
projects.keywords: On-chain Activity / Investor Sentiment / Blockchain / Ethereum
projects.abstract_en:
Investment in cryptocurrencies is increasingly gaining popularity and growth,
precipitating an increase in investor participation. Consequently, for investors to engage
in cryptocurrency investment proficiently, a comprehensive awareness of investor
sentiment becomes imperative. This is owing to the fact that investor sentiment
significantly influences market transactions, as well as investment behaviors and
decision-making processes. This research aims to analyze investor sentiment by
leveraging the public dataset from Google Cloud BigQuery alongside other relatable
blockchain datasets. An Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) system has been created
to integrate data from multiple sources and store it in a database, thereby increasing
data accessibility and simplifying the data importation process in deep learning model
development. This research utilized Convolutional Neural Network, Long Short-Term
Memory (CNN-LSTM), renowned for its efficacy in sequential prediction. The findings
of this study reveal that the CNN-LSTM model adeptly predicts investor sentiment. The
result of this research will be visualized through a dashboard, encompassing investor
sentiment prediction results derived from the deep learning models, current Ethereum
prices, and diverse cryptocurrency market indicators and metrics from on-chain activity
data.

projects.title_th: ParkEase: แอปพลิเคชันจองที่จอดรถ
projects.keywords: Parking Reservation Application, Parking Search, Parking Reservation
projects.abstract_en:
This project focuses on developing a mobile application to facilitate finding, booking, and using parking
spaces. The development process began with researching the problem of parking availability, analyzing
potential solutions, defining the scope of the problem and user needs, outlining the application's
functionalities and system requirements. Subsequently, user experience (UX) design, system design,
application development, user testing, and refinement based on user feedback were conducted.

The application enables users to search for nearby parking locations, view details about each parking
space, and categorize them as reservable or non-reservable. For reservable spots, users can book them for
the same day only, no advance reservations are allowed. Additionally, users can become service providers
by registering as Partners and managing their parking spaces through the application, including accepting
payments.

The project's outcome demonstrates overall user satisfaction with the application, signifying the
achievement of its intended objectives.

projects.keywords: Automated level design / Game / Genetic Algorithm / Procedural Content Generation
projects.abstract_en:
Currently, game development processes require resources such as budget, time, and labor. The
technology that can assist in development is called Procedural Content Generation (PCG), which
includes the Traditional method, Search-Based method, and Machine Learning However, those methods
aren't widely used in current and commercial game development, particularly in areas like level design
and generation that still use human resources more than PCG. We have developed 2.5D action rogue-lite
game with automated level design as a guideline for applied PCG in game development. The result was
successful development of the game and the implementation of PCG.

and services. This project was developed to solve problems and create business opportunities by
analyzing individuals' external characteristics through the application of deep learning techniques,
including a system for detecting and analyzing clothing and appearance to analyze initial data about
consumer tastes and lifestyles. Combined with an advertising recommendation system that collects
external factors about individuals such as age, gender, clothing and appearance to analyze and present
the most suitable and relevant advertising media. Additionally, the system structure is designed to
include a data collection component for camera analysis, a web interface to display in-depth data, and
a data analysis component focused on deep learning efficiency for accurate data that can be used to
analyze customer segments and create a more engaging and desirable advertising viewing experience.

projects.abstract_en:
The project aims to design and develop a web application for classroom project management (Academ
Projex). Nowadays, Software Project Management (SPM) is very important in working in an
organization because it can increase productivity within the organization. According to a survey of ideas
from the students, it was found that the majority of college students have not yet understanding the
importance of SPM. It can be used to track team tasks and reduce confusion in planning. Therefore, the
Academ Projex was developed in the web application platform. The application consists of the
functions such as (1) creating, editing, and deleting projects, (2) creating, editing, and deleting tasks, (3)
reviewing assignments, (4) moving tasks and (5) tracking current or completed tasks and so on.
Moreover, the sampling of 20 students in applied computer science was used for the application
assessment. According to the user satisfaction assessment, the program developed at the level of
satisfaction with the use had an average score of 1.97. In favor and more than standard the satisfaction
score and website recommendation trend was 33.33%, which is also considered favorable

projects.title_th: แอปพลิเคชันบริหารจัดการงานแม่บ้าน
projects.keywords: Housekeeper chores management, Notifications, Mobile application
projects.abstract_en:
The objective of this project is to develop a mobile application to manage housekeeping tasks, in order
to enhance work efficiency, improve task tracking, and address the limitations of current paper-based methods.
These limitations include the inability to effectively track housekeeping tasks, paper-related costs, potential
corruption in task completion, document deterioration, and overall inefficiency. The project methodology
involved analyzing user needs, designing the application, defining its structure, and developing its various
functionalities. The project involved user requirement analysis, application design, system architecture
development, and the implementation of various features, including a login system, task assignment and
reporting, equipment management, repair requests, notifications, and a news feed. The evaluation of the
application involved two groups of domestic workers: those with no technological experience and those with
technological experience. The results indicated that the application was less well-understood and received
lower satisfaction ratings from the group with no technological experience, with an average score of 50 points.
In contrast, the group with technological experience found the application to be more understandable and
satisfactory, with an average score of 82.5 points. Despite these differences in user experience, the application
successfully improved task management and addressed domestic worker-related issues, aligning with the
project's objectives.
 Keywords Housekeeper chores management, Notifications, Mobile application

projects.keywords: – กลุ่มรถยกคนท างานบนที่สูง, การจัดการฟลีท
projects.abstract_en:
The project "Dashboard for forecasting fleet management of mobile elevating work platforms" serves as a
crucial tool to enhance operational efficiency and reduce operational costs. By utilizing technology and
data for efficient resource management, it effectively addresses the needs of fleet management. This
dashboard aggregates and displays key information in real-time, allowing managers to monitor machines
usage, minimize losses from idle time, and ensure worker safety effectively. Additionally, the dashboard
facilitates data analysis and report generation to support data-driven decision-making. The development
and implementation of this dashboard will lead to improved operational efficiency, reduced operational
costs, and increased productivity of aerial work platforms in the long term.

 Keywords – Mobile elevating work platforms, Fleet management

projects.keywords: BERT, MBTI – Myers-Briggs Type Indicator, Psychological,
projects.abstract_en:
This research designed the steps and methods to develop a machine learning model for
the Thai language to classify customers according to psychographic principles. This
research designed the steps and methods to develop a machine learning model for the
Thai language to classify customers according to psychographic principles. The sample
group used in this study was a group of general people on online social media obtained
from the distribution of questionnaires on online platforms and from public figures, and
the experiment was divided into 2 experiments consisting of The experiment divided the
data into 16 personality types according to the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI)
theory, and the experiment divided the data into 4 alphabetical positions. The BERT and
TF-IDF models were used in each experiment for comparison results and use the
Confusion Matrix table and Classification report table for measurement. Comparing all
models across all experiments, it was found that the model and experimental design
with the highest accuracy was the TF-IDF model, based on the experiment splitting data
into 16 personality types with an accuracy of 84 percent. This model can be further
developed into a website for categorizing customers according to psychological theory.

ภาษาไทยเพื่อแบ่งประเภทลูกค้าตามหลักจิตวิทยา โดยกลุ่มตัวอย่างที่ใช้ในการศึกษาครั้งนี้เป็นกลุ่ม

ประเภทบุคลิกภาพ 16 แบบ ที่มีความแม่นย าอยู่ที่ร้อยละ 84 ซึ่งสามารถนาโมเดลนี้ไปพัฒนาเป็นเว็บ

projects.abstract_en:
This project on an image recognition and embedded AI-based waste detection and sorting
system applies machine learning techniques to assist in waste detection. The system processes
images to identify and classify waste, providing notifications regarding the type of waste detected.
The model has been trained using deep learning technology, convolutional neural networks, and
computer vision-based artificial intelligence. It is operationalized with a prototype robotic platform
utilizing high-performance microcontroller boards for processing. The model has been trained with
datasets of various types of waste, enabling it to accurately detect and recognize hazardous waste
through sensors and robotic platforms. This system has demonstrated accuracy of over 80% in waste
detection and recognition and can operate effectively in diverse real-world environments. Therefore,
the waste detection and sorting system based on image recognition and embedded artificial
intelligence can help mitigate the risks associated with waste inspection and promote proper and
efficient waste management.

โครงงานระบบการตรวจจับและคัดแยกขยะบนพื้นฐานการรับรู้ภาพและสมองกลฝังตัวที่
พัฒนาขึ้นนี้ประยุกต์ใช้ขั้นตอนวิธีการเรียนรู้ของเครื่องในการช่วยตรวจจับขยะ โดยระบบจะท าการ
ประมวลผลภาพเพื่อคัดเเยกขยะ และแจ้งเตือนว่าเป็นขยะประเภทใด ซึ่งได้มีการฝึกฝนโมเดลโดยใช้
เทคโนโลยีการเรียนรู้เชิงลึกของเครือข่ายประสาทแบบคอนโวลูชันและการมองเห็นของคอมพิวเตอร์
บนพื้นฐานปัญญาประดิษฐ์ และท าการใช้งานกับรถหุ่นยนต์ต้นแบบโดยมีการใช้บอร์ด
ไมโครคอนโทรลเลอร์ประสิทธิภาพสูงในการประมวลผล โดยโมเดลได้รับการเรียนรู้ด้วยชุดข้อมูล
ของขยะเเต่ละประเภท และสามารถตรวจจับและรู้จ าขยะที่เป็นอันตรายผ่านเซ็นเซอร์และรถหุ่นยนต์
บังคับที่ช่วยลดความเสี่ยงในการสัมผัสกับขยะที่เป็นอันตรายด้วยการบังคับไปยังสถานที่ที่มีขยะที่ไม่
ถูกก าจัดด้วยวิธีที่ถูกต้อง เช่น กองขยะที่ถูกเทกองทิ้งไว้ เป็นต้น โดยจากการทดสอบประสิทธิภาพ
ของโมเดล พบว่าโมเดลสามารถตรวจจับและรู้จ าขยะได้ถูกต้องกว่าร้อยละ 80 และสามารถใช้งานได้
ในสภาพแวดล้อมจริงที่หลากหลายได้ ระบบการตรวจจับและคัดแยกขยะบนพื้นฐานการรับรู้ภาพและ
สมองกลฝังตัวนี้จึงสามารถใช้เพื่อช่วยเลี่ยงอันตรายจากตรวจขยะและเป็นการส่งเสริมการจัดการขยะ
